strings.en: Feel the power of the Black Flame Hunter!
Just hold still and be hunted.
I'll carry out the mission I was given.
I hunt the prey before me. Nothing more.
Feel the power of Galilnagant firsthand.
I'll carry out the orders I was given.
No mercy for those who stand in my way!
I'll burn your obsession away with black flame.
Let's see the power of a so-called Fury Knight.
Hmph, so you're a black hunter too.
I'll teach you that you're the hunted one, too!
Savor your sham of a throne while you can!
Shu needn't trouble himself with you.
Let's see how long you can keep that cool face.
Gomoudokka.../　I'll be your opponent in Shu's place.
That scythe won't stop my gun-axe.
You're the one who'll be stained in blood, Reggiane!
Herluga, that power is beyond you!
Hmph, to think there'd be a giant like that.
Whoever built that machine, if it's an enemy, I hunt it!
I'll shatter those bones with my gun-axe!
You're nothing but a remnant of Kadum Hakam!
XN-L.../　Be wreathed in black flame and meet your end!
Wherever you came from.../　this is where you end!
A machine like that is no match for Galilnagant!
Unsatisfying prey, but I won't show mercy.
Prey that might be worth hunting, for once?
Let's see how far that performance gets you...!
You'll get more than scorch marks!
At that speed,/　you'll never catch Galilnagant!
Combined or not, it's still just Lamaris.
That Kaana type is my prey!
No matter how big you swell, black flame will burn you!
Lamaris Ida.../　You're still just prey!
Where do you think you're going?
Hmph, you didn't even realize you were lured out...!
I'll make you regret who you picked a fight with!
To think I'd be forced to retreat...!!
I failed to complete the mission...!
To think you'd push Galilnagant this far...!
If I fall so pathetically, I can't fulfill Shu's orders!
There's a time lag in the Active Wings...!
Ngh, the Tronium Rev's output is...!
Until I fulfill Shu's orders,/　I can't fall...!
This one's on another level from the other Raftclans...!
Does he mean to wreck their own spaceship too?!
So this is Vort's true power!
You're one push short of drawing my blood!
Has it seized the power/　of the Cross Gate...?!
I have to see through the clown's tricks...!
Skull Knight... Not to the likes of you!
Whatever it takes,/　I have to stop XN-L here...!
To fall behind such small fry...!
Now you've made me serious, Fury!
So swarming together does give you some power!
Not bad, but you can't finish the job.
Heh heh heh... Prey worth hunting.
A hit. But it won't hinder my mission.
Don't think that's enough to corner me.
Ngh, it's not as if I'm out of practice...!
I can't become a burden to my master...!
Tch, the waist motor is catching.
You've had some proper training, it seems.
...So you're worthy of wearing black after all.
I have no intention of being hunted by you, Karo-Ran!
To be outwitted by a woman like that...
I won't let you have your way any longer, Gomoudokka!
Hmph... So he's finally getting serious.
...Why don't you try falling into the Cross Gate?
Crystal Dragoon!/　I have no intention of being your prey!
I can't stop the Skull Knight...!
So it's not the same as/　the Kadum Hakam of La Gias...!
Ngh... Even it can't be immortal!
Ngh, I can't leave that Lamaris alone!
So this is the power of the revived Ares Geist...
Attacks like this aren't worth dodging.
What's wrong? Is just hitting me your limit?
Your power can't bring down Galilnagant.
Is hanging on all you can manage, Jua-Mu?
So that's the fruit of your research.
Hmph, just a clown after all.
Are you holding back, Crystal Dragoon?
The Skull Knight got in close...!
XN-L, things won't go the way you want.
I have no intention of playing with Lamaris.
You can't keep up with the Galilnagant!
You think that will catch me?
You're not worthy of wearing that color.
What's wrong? Is that scythe just for show?
Hmph, the Cross Gate is jerking you around.
No matter how much junk you control!
Clown... What are you playing at?
Hmph, are those wings just for show?
What are you holding that spear for?
You're slower than the Kadum Hakam of La Gias.
Upper class or not, your performance is half-baked.
No barrage you put up will do any good.
Lamaris are no match for me.
Prey that struggles to the last.
Fine. I'll let you go this time.
So you fear me, do you?
So you're not just attacking blindly, then.
Hmph. Run wherever you like. It's useless.
It's too early to let your guard down!
I've got it in my sights too!
You're careless at the finish, Masaki.
My master's orders. I'll support the Masoukishin.
Shu, you're saying to leave the rest to me?
I obey my master... That is my duty.
If you're my master's ally, I'll support you.
We're in similar positions. I'll support you.
That unit... I feel like I have to pursue it.
I won't let you have your way!
I won't let you hit your mark!
Shu told you not to be reckless, didn't he?
My master's orders. I'll protect the Masoukishin.
I won't let you lay a hand on my master!
Covering for him, of all people...
We're in similar positions. I'll cover you.
Granteed Dracodeus.../　I suppose I have to protect it.
You've got nowhere left to run!
Taste the edge of the Buster Axe!
Savor it to your heart's content!!
With my master's leave, I unleash my power...!
I'll send you beyond the void...!
